name: Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme
benefit:
**Medical Treatment Packages** Comprehensive treatment packages ranging from ₹1,000/- to ₹45,000/- covering various types of injuries:
**Package-wise Benefits** - Simple Injury-I (Package 1): ₹1,000/- for treating simple wounds, injection Tetanus Vaccination, analgesic, antibiotics, general conditions check, cleaning, suturing and dressing - Simple Injury-II (Package 2): ₹2,500/- including
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a victim of road traffic accident. - The applicant must require immediate medical treatment for injuries sustained in the accident. - The applicant must receive treatment at hospitals empanelled under the Vahan Aksmat Sahay Scheme. - The applicant must have Medico Legal Case registered for the accident. - The applicant must have police intimation with acknowledgment for the road traffic accident.
